name: Browser Calling & Chat
desc: A WebRTC application for calls and chat in the browser.
overview: The project brings voice communication and text conversations into a browser-based experience.

name: AI Item Classification
desc: An AI project that sorts items into categories using their size and shape.
overview: Size and shape are the distinguishing features in this classification task. The project explores how those physical attributes can be used to group items.

name: Company Research Automation
desc: A spreadsheet-to-spreadsheet workflow for researching companies on the web.
overview: The workflow starts with a company list in Excel, uses browser searches to research each entry, and organizes findings into the required Excel format.

name: Naukri Resume Automation
desc: A recruitment workflow for authorized résumé downloads from Naukri.
overview: The scope is résumé retrieval within a recruiter's authorized access and the platform's terms. The illustration represents the document workflow using abstract shapes.

name: ERPNext & Frappe Solutions
desc: ERPNext implementation, consulting and custom applications built with Frappe.
overview: This case study is reserved for a closer look at ERPNext customization and the role of Frappe applications in a business workflow.

name: Real Estate CRM
desc: A planned case study on customer relationship management in real estate.
overview: The intended focus is CRM workflows and integrations in the real estate sector. Project-specific contributions and results are pending confirmation.

name: Election Fulcrum
desc: An online election system for candidate registration, document verification and election administration.
overview: The application brings candidate records and verification into a single administrative workflow. Its design includes separate credentials for candidates and voters.

name: Hotel Management System
desc: A hotel operations project connecting front-desk tasks with housekeeping workflows.
overview: The project covers check-in and check-out, room assignments and room-status updates for housekeeping staff.

name: Children’s Mental Health Website
desc: An educational website bringing mental health awareness resources and wellbeing videos together.
overview: The site organizes introductory reading, yoga tips and videos in one place for visitors exploring mental wellbeing.

name: Children’s Mental Health Application
desc: A questionnaire-based application exploring anxiety, depression and stress.
overview: The application groups self-reported responses by topic. The project focuses on the questionnaire experience and the organization of responses.

name: Personal Portfolio
desc: An earlier edition of my personal site, presenting my development work and experience.
overview: This edition collected project previews, technology skills and career information in a static portfolio.
